documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 15, 2026
Communication To Shareholders- Intimation Of Tax Deduction On Final Dividend

analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong start to Q1 FY27 with pre-sales growing 567% year-on-year to INR409 crores and collections rising 115% to INR150 crores. Profit after tax increased 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, achieving a PAT margin of 34.5%. Management reaffirmed its full-year FY27 guidance for pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%. The company maintains a net cash balance sheet and plans to launch additional projects over the remaining quarters of FY27. Sri Lotus Developers & Realty Limited reported a strong start for Q1 FY27 with robust business momentum and healthy demand for its luxury and ultra-luxury residential portfolio.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales ranging from INR1,800 to 2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are expected to be in the range of 35% to 40%.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company guided for FY27 pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this robust launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we are confident of achieving our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury buyers are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle rather than loan rates.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, along with high enquiry levels for luxury residential units at the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Newly launched projects are seeing good traction and enquiries with strong customer interest.
demand_outlook.quote: Both projects were launched towards the end of June and are seeing good traction and enquiries, with construction commenced and strong customer interest, providing a healthy pipeline for future sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Buyers are increasingly preferring larger residences, enhanced amenities, wellness-focused living, and trusted brand developments.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also witnessing strong absorption levels across key micro markets with buyers increasingly preferring larger residences, enhanced amenities, wellness-focused living, and developments backed by trusted brands.

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we further expanded our development portfolio with the launch of Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded in the GIFT City Area with a flagship ultra-luxury mixed-use project.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion in GIFT City Area with Flagship Ultra Luxury Project

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City Area project has an estimated GDV of INR 2,000-2,200 Crs and is expected to commence in Q1 FY28 with completion targeted in FY31.
During FY26, the company added nine new projects with a cumulative GDV of approximately INR8,500 crores to INR9,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY26, we added nine new projects with a cumulative GDV of approximately INR8,500 crores to INR9,000 crores, significantly strengthening our development pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company marked its strategic entry into GIFT City during the year, further expanding its geographic presence.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we also marked our strategic entry into GIFT City, further expanding our geographic presence.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with an EBITDA margin of 36.4% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have risen by approximately 7%, while labor costs have increased by around 5%.
margins_costs.quote: Input costs have risen by approximately 7%, while labor costs have increased by around 5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 39.4% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 39.4% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR281 crores with EBITDA margin at 36.5% for financial year 2026.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR281 crores with EBITDA margin at 36.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Seventeen out of the 22 projects are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

orders_capacity.claim: Total carpet area of the current project portfolio is approximately 4.0 mn. sq. ft.
Estimated GDV for ongoing residential projects is approximately 4,500-4,700 Crs.
orders_capacity.quote: Estimated GDV for the ongoing projects is ~4,500-4,700 Crs.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q4 FY26 stood at INR462 crores, registering a strong growth of 177% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales for Q4 FY26 stood at INR462 crores, registering a strong growth of 177% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: For the full year ended March 2026, the company achieved pre-sales of INR1,157 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: For the full year ended March 2026, we achieved pre-sales of INR1,157 crores, in line with our stated guidance, despite industry-wide challenges.

capital_allocation.claim: The company had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR271 crores has been deployed as on June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: Net proceeds from the fresh issue of IPO amounting to INR 550 Crs are allocated for investment in subsidiaries for part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has approved a dividend payout of 50% for FY26, and the promoter group has voluntarily waived its dividend entitlement to retain the amount for new project additions.
capital_allocation.quote: Before I conclude, I would like to share that the Board has approved a dividend payout of 50% for FY26. In line with its long-term growth vision, the promoter group has voluntarily waived its dividend entitlement for FY26. The retained amount will be utilized for new project additions and project development.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash as on 31st March 2026 stood at INR697 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash as on 31st March 2026 stood at INR697 crores.
